## [Safer, Smarter, and More Productive][15]

VPG sensors, weighing solutions, and measurement systems deliver the highest levels of accuracy and
reliability when precision matters. 

Driven by innovation, our precision measurement sensing technologies begin with deep engineering and
applications expertise to provide specialized solutions in a broad range of markets, including test
and measurement, avionics, military and space, transportation, steel, industrial, medical,
agriculture, and consumer.

We are proud to do our part in making the world safer, smarter, and more productive.

All LEEYD DC shunts use ROHS, REACH & Prop 65-compliant materials — safe, tested, and export-ready.

**Material Compliance That Keeps You Market-Ready**
For many brands and buyers, compliance isn’t a checkbox — it’s a dealbreaker. At **LEEYD**, we treat
compliance as part of the product, not an afterthought. Every DC Shunt we produce meets strict
global standards, giving you clarity, confidence, and documentation you can count on.

**1. ROHS – EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances**
We use ROHS-compliant materials in all our shunts, ensuring they are free of lead, mercury, cadmium,
and other restricted substances. This is essential for electronics integration and smooth customs
clearance in Europe and beyond.

**2. REACH – EU Chemical Safety Regulation**
Our materials are fully registered under REACH, ensuring transparency and long-term compliance in
the EU. This minimizes legal risk and protects your brand from regulatory disruption or supply chain
issues.

**3. CA Prop 65 – California Consumer Safety Law**
Our products are screened for chemicals regulated under Prop 65 — including phthalates and heavy
metals — so you can safely sell in North America without triggering warning label requirements or
compliance headaches.

the EU. This minimizes legal risk and protects your brand from regulatory disruption or supply chain

# [[Miba Resistors Logo]][28]Miba Resistors

[EBG Produkte, im Hintergrund Landschaft mit E-Auto, Zug, Stromleitungen und Windkraftanlage]

# Miba Resistors

Die Miba Resistors ist ein international führender Hersteller in der Entwicklung und Produktion von
nicht-induktiven Dickschicht-Widerständen für die Hochleistungselektronik. Unsere technologisch hoch
anspruchsvollen Komponenten tragen dazu bei, dass Energie sicher und effizient umgewandelt und
übertragen wird. Ob Hochleistungswiderstände, Hochspannungswiderstände oder kundenspezifische
Ausführungen - unser Solution Team begleitet Sie über den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

# Gemeinsam entwickeln wir die optimale
# Widerstandslösung für Ihre Anforderung

 

Unsere Produkte sind in verschiedenen Leistungs- und Spannungsbereichen, Größen, engen Toleranzen
sowie Ohmwerten erhältlich.
Dank des technischen Know-hows und der langjährigen Erfahrung ist die Miba Resistors in der Lage
schnell und flexibel neuen Anforderungen zu entsprechen.

# Unsere Produkte zur Leistungselektronik im Überblick

[EBG Leistungswiderstand mit bis zu 600W] Wir sind führend in der Entwicklung von induktionsfreien
Dickschicht Leistungswiderständen, die besonders kompakt und leistungsfähig sind. Sie regulieren
etwa Spannungsspitzen, wie sie beim Ein- und Ausschalten von elektronischen High-End-Geräten
entstehen, und leiten Überspannungen ab.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][29]
Wir erzeugen eine große Bandbreite an unterschiedlichen induktionsfreien
Ultra-Hochleistungswiderständen. Für kleine Bauformen bietet die Miba Widerstände mit
Leistungsstufen zwischen 350 W und 3.000 W, die direkt auf Kühlkörpern montiert werden können
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][30]
[EBG Hochspannungswiderstand vor weißem Hintergrund] Unsere induktionsfreien
Hochspannungswiderstände sind besonders leistungsfähig. Sie können sehr hohe Spannungen regulieren,
um diese einfach messbar und den Umgang damit sicherer zu machen. Eine wichtige Rolle spielen die
Hochspannungswiderstände deshalb in Netzgeräten zur Energieversorgung von hochwertigen Maschinen wie
Röntgengeräten oder Laboranlagen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][31]
[flache EBG Widerstände] Unsere Hochspannungswiderstände sind auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden
abgestimmt. Diese individuellen Spezifizierungen machen sie für die jeweiligen Anwendungen besonders
leistungsfähig. Sie sind zudem in der Lage, sehr hohe Spannungen zu regulieren, um diese einfach
messbar und den Umgang damit sicherer zu machen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][32]
[EBG Ultra-Hochleistungswiderstand vor weißem Hintergrund] Wir produzieren Shunts in drei
unterschiedlichen Leistungsklassen und Vier-Kontakt-Kelvin-Anschlüssen. Die Widerstände zeichnen
sich durch hohe Isolationsfestigkeit und geringen Temperaturkoeffizienten aus. Anwendung finden
unsere Shunts beispielswiese in der Strommessung bzw. Stromüberwachung.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][33]
[EBG Metallschicht Widerstände vor weißem Hintergrund] Unsere Metallfilmwiderstände zeichnen sich
durch besonders hohe Genauigkeit hinsichtlich Ohmwert, Temperaturkoeffizient und Langzeitstabilität
aus. Wir bieten eine große Auswahl an verschiedenen Bauformen mit entsprechenden Leistungsklassen,
von radialen und axialen Bauformen bis hin zu nach MIL-Standard getesteten Elementen. Für extreme
Einsatzbedingungen gibt es auch gemoldete Bauformen.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][34]
[EBG Ultra-Hochpräzisionswiderstand vor weißem Hintergrund] Wir haben neue Materialkombinationen und
Verarbeitungsprozesse entwickelt, die einen TCR (thermischer Widerstandskoeffizient) bei Miba
Resistors typischem minimalen VCR (Spannungskoeffizient) von bis zu +/- 5ppm ermöglichen. Diese neue
Generation von hochpräzisen und hochstabilen Widerständen wird in ersten Anwendungen, zum Beispiel
in Strom- und Spannungsversorgungseinrichtungen in der Medizintechnik, bereits erfolgreich
eingesetzt.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][35]
[EBG Spannungsteiler vor weißem Hintergrund] Wir entwickeln und produzieren eine Vielzahl an
Bauformen und Größen von Spannungsteilen. Je nach Anwendungsgebiet (Luft, Öl, gepottet, etc.) werden
verschiedene Ausführungen hergestellt und bieten höchste Präzision und Stabilität.
[MEHR ERFAHREN >][36]

## Electronics Devices Articles

][115]Learn about the many different types of electronic devices. We go over basic electronics,
semiconductors, diodes, transistors, LEDS, [Printed Circuit Boards][116], MOSFETS, and more.
[

## Digital Electronics Articles

][117]Digital Electronic deals with digital or discrete signals. We cover binary number systems,
binary arithmetic, boolean algebra, De Morgan theorems, K-map, logic gates, and binary to other
number system conversion. We also explain the basic electronic circuits of various logic gates.
[

## Electrical Power Generation Articles

][118]Learn about all types of electrical power generation systems including thermal, hydro, nuclear
power generation, solar panels, wind energy electric generation, cogeneration and more. We explain
the working principles and characteristics of different components of [power plants][119], like
boilers, turbines, economisers, solar panel, and wind turbines.
[

## Switchgear Articles

][120]Learn about all three types of electrical switchgear systems – low voltage switchgear, medium
voltage switchgear and high voltage switchgear – and the individual components of an electrical
switchgear system. We explain the mechanisms, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of different
parts of switchgear – including like CBs, CTs, CVTs, PT, isolators, and more.
[

## Power Transmission System Articles

][121]Articles related to electrical power transmission systems. Learn about different transmission
parameters, different materials used to construct a transmission line, HVDC systems, and different
theoretical approaches to power transmission. We discuss the design aspects of transmission towers
and their foundations.
[

## Electrical Generator Articles

][122]The electrical generator is the most basic as well as a most expensive component of a power
system. There are mainly two types of generators AC and DC Generator. One of the most common forms
of AC Generator is an alternator. We have provided various detailed articles on generators in this
generator section of the website – helping you to understand the basic concepts of generators.
[

## Electrical Transformer Articles

][123]We discuss all things related to transformers – from fundamental theory to modern advancement.
Learn about all different types of transformers – two winding transformers, autotransformers, power
and distribution transformers, single phase and three phase transformers – and more.

## Built for Advanced Hardware Supply Chains

We support engineering and procurement teams that need more than a spot-buy distributor: multi-line
BOM review, shortage sourcing, lifecycle risk checks, supplier consolidation and PCBA coordination.

#### [BOM Sourcing][110]

[ [circuit board design principles, close-up shot of a complex printed circuit board (PCB) with
various electronic components and interconnected copper traces, matte finish, high resolution,

technical, engineering, precision, PCBA Insights: Connecting Components with Precision] ][111]
ICs, memory, power, connectors, sensors and passives sourced as one controlled BOM package, with
availability and substitution support.

#### [Quality & Traceability][112]

[ [Radio components, tantalum SMD capacitor] ][113]
Resistors, capacitors, inductors, crystals and filters — precise, reliable and in stock, ready to

#### [PCBA Support][114]

From component procurement to SMT assembly support, we help turn a BOM into reliable prototypes,
pilot runs and production builds.

## Controlled Sourcing for Long-Lifecycle Programs

#### Verified Inventory for BOM Consolidation

We review BOM lines against real stock, supplier channels, date-code needs and delivery risk, then
consolidate sourcing into a cleaner RFQ and delivery workflow.

## Why High-Reliability Buyers Trust Informic

### BOM accuracy, real stock, traceability and responsive communication for demanding electronics
### programs.

[ Request a Quote ][119]

#### 100% Incoming Inspection

Every lot is checked — visual, X-ray, decapsulation and solderability testing — to screen out
counterfeit and refurbished parts.

#### 13 Years, Real Stock

5M+ line items across franchised and independent brands, shipped from our own Shenzhen warehouse.

#### Fast, Honest Quotes

Reply within 12 hours with date code, packaging and price up front — backed by a 3-year warranty.

#### Built for AI Supply Chains

GPUs, memory, power management and PCBA under one roof, including allocated and shortage parts.

## Industries We Support

### AI Servers, Industrial Control, Automotive Electronics and Mission-Critical Systems

Our current customer base includes automotive, industrial and consumer electronics. The upgraded
sourcing workflow also supports AI/data-center and other high-reliability applications where
delivery stability and part authenticity matter.

After a long day at work or after a full week of caring for your home and children, it is time for
relaxation, your **hobby hour**. Hobbies will keep you occupied between work and family, and
cultivating a good hobby may have calming or helpful therapeutic side effects.

Hobbies are practiced for enjoyment and interest, rather than financial reward. Engaging in a hobby
can lead to acquiring substantial knowledge, skill and experience, but the most important gain is
your personal fulfillment.

What are hobbies for some people are professions for others: a programmer may enjoy [guitar
playing][4] as a hobby, while a professional musician might enjoy programming. But remember that
Linux began as a student's hobby.

A hobby doesn't have to cost a fortune to be enjoyable. Activities like [sport fishing][5] can be
maintained for a reasonable amount spent on equipment and travel, paper-making requires little more
than junk mail and a blender, and so on.

[Eurasian Hobby] **The history of the word "hobby":**
Falconry was a very popular pastime in the Middle Ages and the "Eurasian Hobby" was perhaps the most
popular bird used for this sport.
An alternative origin for the word can be accounted for a recreational animal called hobby - a type
of small ambling or pacing horse. A hobby-horse was a wooden toy made to be ridden just like the
real hobby. From this came the expression "to ride one's hobby-horse", meaning "to follow your
favorite pastime", and in turn, hobby in the modern sense of recreation.

embroidery or performing an **outdoor activity** like climbing, hiking or bird watching.

Creating something **useful** or making a **handcrafted item** for decoration can be both practical
and profitable. Acting, play writing, poetry, playing an instrument, collecting music tapes, or
writing song lyrics are all good ways to spend a quality time.

**Radio controlled** model cars, airplanes, helicopters or boats have opened up a wide spread,
interesting recreational activity. Previously sold as toys, today's RC devices are expanding rapidly
in complexity and variety.

Board and card games like chess, checkers or mah-jongg are a great way to stimulate your mind and

thing is that you have fun with whatever hobby you choose!

After a long day at work or after a full week of caring for your home and children, it is time for
relaxation, your **hobby hour**. Hobbies will keep you occupied between work and family, and
cultivating a good hobby may have calming or helpful therapeutic side effects.

Hobbies are practiced for enjoyment and interest, rather than financial reward. Engaging in a hobby
can lead to acquiring substantial knowledge, skill and experience, but the most important gain is
your personal fulfillment.

What are hobbies for some people are professions for others: a programmer may enjoy [guitar
playing][4] as a hobby, while a professional musician might enjoy programming. But remember that
Linux began as a student's hobby.

A hobby doesn't have to cost a fortune to be enjoyable. Activities like [sport fishing][5] can be
maintained for a reasonable amount spent on equipment and travel, paper-making requires little more
than junk mail and a blender, and so on.

[Eurasian Hobby] **The history of the word "hobby":**
Falconry was a very popular pastime in the Middle Ages and the "Eurasian Hobby" was perhaps the most
popular bird used for this sport.
An alternative origin for the word can be accounted for a recreational animal called hobby - a type
of small ambling or pacing horse. A hobby-horse was a wooden toy made to be ridden just like the
real hobby. From this came the expression "to ride one's hobby-horse", meaning "to follow your
favorite pastime", and in turn, hobby in the modern sense of recreation.

**collecting items** like coins, stamps, baseball cards, **working with your hands** like sewing,
embroidery or performing an **outdoor activity** like climbing, hiking or bird watching.

Creating something **useful** or making a **handcrafted item** for decoration can be both practical
and profitable. Acting, play writing, poetry, playing an instrument, collecting music tapes, or
writing song lyrics are all good ways to spend a quality time.

**Radio controlled** model cars, airplanes, helicopters or boats have opened up a wide spread,
interesting recreational activity. Previously sold as toys, today's RC devices are expanding rapidly

Board and card games like chess, checkers or mah-jongg are a great way to stimulate your mind and

## About Us

**CHANGZHOU YUANSHENG TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD**

**Reliable Power Resistor Solutions for Industrial Electronics**

Since 2013, Changzhou Yuansheng Technology has been specializing in the design and manufacturing of
high-performance passive components for industrial applications.

Our core products include **ultra-low inductance high power resistors, dynamic braking resistors,
PCB metal shunt jumper bars, manganin/constantan shunt resistors, SMD alloy resistors, ceramic
cement resistors, and air core coils**. These components are widely used in industrial automation,
power electronics, motor drives, energy storage systems, power supplies, and other demanding
applications where stable performance and long-term reliability are essential.

With manufacturing partners and production resources across Jiangsu and surrounding regions, we
combine engineering support, flexible customization, and reliable production capability to meet
different application requirements. From prototype development to volume production, we work closely
with customers to provide practical resistor solutions based on electrical performance, mechanical
requirements, and application conditions.

 

Learn More

Our focus is not only supplying components, but helping customers reduce design risks through
consistent quality, accurate specifications, and dependable technical support.

**Yuansheng Technology — Your trusted partner for industrial power resistor solutions.**

Our team works closely with customers to understand electrical, mechanical, and application
requirements, providing reliable resistor solutions with flexible customization, responsive
technical support, and competitive cost advantages. By combining consistent quality, stable supply
capability, and efficient manufacturing processes, we help customers achieve better performance and
cost balance for their industrial applications.

## The Value We Bring to Your Projects

From component selection to production support, we help customers achieve reliable resistor
performance through engineering expertise, consistent quality, flexible customization, and
dependable supply.

### Reliable Performance

Consistent materials and manufacturing control ensure stable resistance performance and reliable
power handling.

### Application Engineering Support

Technical support for resistor selection, customization, and application requirements from prototype
development to production.

### Accurate Power Capability

Designed with reliable power handling capability to reduce overheating risks and ensure stable
operation under demanding conditions.

### Flexible Manufacturing

Supporting customized specifications, small-batch prototypes, and volume production with responsive
manufacturing capability.

## Solutions Designed for Industrial Power Systems

Reliable resistor solutions for power electronics, industrial control, and energy applications

### Power Electronics Applications

Motor drives, power supplies, and energy systems..

### Thermal & Load Management

Energy absorption and current control.

### Custom Component Solutions

Resistance values, dimensions, and specifications.

## About Us

**CHANGZHOU YUANSHENG TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD**

**Reliable Power Resistor Solutions for Industrial Electronics**

Since 2013, Changzhou Yuansheng Technology has been specializing in the design and manufacturing of
high-performance passive components for industrial applications.

Our core products include **ultra-low inductance high power resistors, dynamic braking resistors,
PCB metal shunt jumper bars, manganin/constantan shunt resistors, SMD alloy resistors, ceramic
cement resistors, and air core coils**. These components are widely used in industrial automation,
power electronics, motor drives, energy storage systems, power supplies, and other demanding
applications where stable performance and long-term reliability are essential.

With manufacturing partners and production resources across Jiangsu and surrounding regions, we
combine engineering support, flexible customization, and reliable production capability to meet
different application requirements. From prototype development to volume production, we work closely
with customers to provide practical resistor solutions based on electrical performance, mechanical
requirements, and application conditions.

 

Learn More

Our focus is not only supplying components, but helping customers reduce design risks through
consistent quality, accurate specifications, and dependable technical support.

**Yuansheng Technology — Your trusted partner for industrial power resistor solutions.**

Our team works closely with customers to understand electrical, mechanical, and application
requirements, providing reliable resistor solutions with flexible customization, responsive
technical support, and competitive cost advantages. By combining consistent quality, stable supply
capability, and efficient manufacturing processes, we help customers achieve better performance and
cost balance for their industrial applications.

## The Value We Bring to Your Projects

From component selection to production support, we help customers achieve reliable resistor
performance through engineering expertise, consistent quality, flexible customization, and
dependable supply.

### Reliable Performance

Consistent materials and manufacturing control ensure stable resistance performance and reliable
power handling.

### Application Engineering Support

Technical support for resistor selection, customization, and application requirements from prototype
development to production.

### Accurate Power Capability

Designed with reliable power handling capability to reduce overheating risks and ensure stable
operation under demanding conditions.

### Flexible Manufacturing

Supporting customized specifications, small-batch prototypes, and volume production with responsive
manufacturing capability.

## Company Overview

Sichuan Qixing Electronics Co., Ltd. is specialized in manufacturing high-power resisters,
wire-wound potentiometers, trimmer potentiometers, rotary carbon potentiometers, precision parts and
so on ...... Engaged in civil and war industrial products for many years, we enfore ISO9001, ISO2000
quality control systems strictly. Our products are widely used in electronic communication products,
instrument measuring appliances, cable TV equipments, electrician products, color television, color
console, video and audio products and many other products. In order to maintain a leading position
in the industry, we have further strengthened our product development ability. Moreover, we took the
lead in introducing the world leading high temperature polymerization furnaces from the USA to
establish ceramic resistance element production line. QIXING has 500 workers at present, among whom
we are proud of our 56 professionals(35 of them got over 10 years' experience in potentiometer/
high-power resister). To satisfy our customers' needs, we provide product design and developing
servises, OEM services, best aftersales servises and give best support once customer got a new idea.
Providing massive acknowledged products to the war and civil industry units, our company has made
certain contribution to the motherland national defense and the thriving of our economy. "Technical
innovation, striving for perfection, keeping on improving, continuously satisfying customers" is our
company's quality policy, and "let customers be satisfied completely" is our goal. All our staff
members are zealously creating a magnificent tomorrow with wit and diligence!
